# draw conclusions from it.

# The production fit's REAL source closure lives in `design/fit_targets.yml`
# under `- top: zhao_prod_top` (148 files today), and that is what
# `tools/quartus/check_prod_manifest.py::check_fit_sources` walks and what the
# fit actually compiles. A repo-wide grep for this filename returns nothing:
# no script, no QSF, no tcl, no yml. It was written once, in 0e8b1c9d, and
# never wired up.
#
# WHY THE HEADER RATHER THAN A DELETION. On 2026-09-09 a sweep read this file
# as the production source list, found `zhao_texture_island_v3_top` and
# `zhao_raster_perspuv_pairpipe` absent from it while `zhao_raster_perspuv_svc`
# -- superseded -- was still present, and reported a source-list gap
# "correlated with" both zhao_prod_top fits dying at quartus_map. Every one of
# those observations about THIS FILE is true. The conclusion does not follow,
# because this file is not in the fit's path at all, and the real list contains
# all three. Checked before implementing: the exciting explanation is the one to
# check hardest, and this one did not survive.
#
# A stale artefact that LOOKS authoritative is worse than no artefact. This
# header is here so the next reader stops at the first line instead of
